prompts.announcement: Use case: illustration-story. Create one landscape 16:9 cinematic story illustration for Shepherd Adventure. Reference image is style only: Follow the Light AA, semi-realistic polished 3D game art, natural human proportions, tactile oatmeal linen, wool, leather, limestone, restrained painterly distant scenery, deep blue Judean night and warm ivory angel light. Show exactly THREE adult shepherds together in the lower-left/center, distinct believable faces, one dark curly-haired bearded man in cream fleece vest and gray-beige knee-length tunic, two companions in muted earth-tone robes. They gaze in wonder at one luminous ivory-robed winged angel hovering in the upper-right. Sheep and sparse grass, distant modest Bethlehem limestone village. Compose all four characters clearly within central 85% of frame. Leave uncluttered dark sky at upper-left for an HTML speech/thought bubble added later. No text or bubble baked into image, no watermark, no modern objects. Reverent, welcoming, hopeful, beautiful lighting.
prompts.nativity: Use case: illustration-story. One landscape 16:9 story illustration, Nativity arrival for Shepherd Adventure. Input reference gives Follow the Light AA style: polished semi-realistic 3D game art, natural proportions, tactile linen wool worn wood limestone straw, cool indigo night and intimate amber lantern light, gentle hopeful reverence. Show Mary in muted blue and cream veil and Joseph in earthy robe beside newborn Jesus wrapped in linen lying in a simple straw-filled manger, under an open humble limestone-and-timber shelter. Exactly THREE adult shepherds have arrived: dark curly-haired bearded lead with cream fleece vest gray-beige tunic, two companions in muted earthy robes and headcloths. One kneels near manger in grateful reverence, others stand with open hands and joyful quiet expressions, all facing baby. Clear human anatomy, believable understated faces. Wide composition with every person visible, no close cropping, subjects mostly central. Night visible outside, soft warm lamp within. No kings, crowns, gifts, extra visitors, text, watermark or speech bubbles. Leave bottom edge low-detail for captions.
